mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.doc_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.comment_content, c.like_count, c.is_anonymous, c.status, c.create_time, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE u.nick_name END as userName, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '' ELSE u.avatar END as avatar FROM kb_doc_comments c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.create_by = u.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.doc_id = #{docId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.doc_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.comment_content, c.like_count, c.is_anonymous, c.status, c.create_time, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE u.nick_name END as userName, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '' ELSE u.avatar END as avatar, CASE WHEN c.is_anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名用户' ELSE ru.nick_name END as replyToUserName FROM kb_doc_comments c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.create_by = u.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON c.reply_to_user_id = ru.user_id AND ru.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_doc_comments WHERE del_flag = '0' AND doc_id = #{docId} AND status = 1
